object_description: complex of a two-storey elongated base, a single-storey terrace and a high six-storey structure
geometry_property: prefabricated grey concrete with white plastered sections
design_condition: the programme is divided into three functional areas of sport, community and teaching, forming a building complex on the upper edge of the site shaped by those uses
